name: places
title: Places
summary: Browse places on a map and in a list, search by area, text or distance, submit places for review, save favourites.

env.name: PLACES_CATEGORIES
env.doc: Place categories as comma-separated id:Label pairs; ids are stored on places, so rename labels freely but keep ids.

env.name: PLACES_REQUIRE_APPROVAL
env.doc: true: user submissions and owner edits wait in the staff queue before they show on the map.

env.name: PLACES_MAP_STYLE_URL
env.doc: MapLibre style JSON the web map loads (OpenFreeMap needs no key).

env.name: PLACES_DEFAULT_CENTER
env.doc: lat,lng the map opens on before it knows the user's location; also biases address search.

env.name: PLACES_DEFAULT_ZOOM
env.doc: Zoom level (0 to 22) the map opens at.

env.name: PLACES_SERVICE_AREA
env.doc: minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat; places outside it are refused. Empty accepts anywhere.

env.name: MAPBOX_TOKEN
env.doc: Mapbox token for geocoding. Empty uses Photon (OpenStreetMap, no key).
env.source: account.mapbox.com → Tokens (server token, no URL restriction)

env.name: PLACES_PHOTON_URL
env.doc: Photon base URL when MAPBOX_TOKEN is empty. The public instance is fair-use only; self-host for volume.

env.name: PLACES_GEOCODE_COUNTRIES
env.doc: Comma-separated ISO country codes (us,ca) address search is limited to. Empty searches worldwide.

env.name: PLACES_GEOCODE_RATE_PER_MIN
env.doc: Upstream geocoding calls per minute across all users; cached answers don't count.

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_ANDROID_KEY
env.doc: Google Maps SDK for Android key for expo-maps, injected into app.config at build time (iOS uses Apple Maps, no key).
env.source: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → Credentials; restrict to the Android package and signing SHA-1 (add Play App Signing's SHA-1 after the first upload)

stitch: Set PLACES_CATEGORIES, PLACES_DEFAULT_CENTER and PLACES_SERVICE_AREA for the app's city and domain.
Decide who may submit places (default: any signed-in, active user; staff approve when PLACES_REQUIRE_APPROVAL=true).
With approval off, places are user-generated content that goes live at once: install moderation and call places.SetContentFilter(moderation.Check) from an app file.
Name OpenStreetMap/Photon or Mapbox, and Google (Android maps), in the privacy policy: address searches and map tiles go to them.
Production geocoding: set MAPBOX_TOKEN or point PLACES_PHOTON_URL at a self-hosted Photon; the public Photon is fair-use only.

Mobile: create the Android Maps key (package + SHA-1, plus Play App Signing's after the first upload), set EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_ANDROID_KEY in each EAS environment, and rebuild the dev client (plugins/withPlaces.js raises iOS to 17.0).
